segments.he: בְּיוֹם חֲמִישִׁי חָזַרְתִּי וְהָלַכְתִּי עַל מְעָרַת רַב כַּהֲנָא וְתַלְמִידָיו:
segments.en: On Friday — I returned and went to the Beis HaChayyim. And I was at the grave of Rabbi Mendil Premishlaner and other Tzadikim. And afterward I returned and went until I came to the grave of the Tanna Rabbi Meir Baal HaNes. From there I went to the hot springs of Tiberias. On holy Shabbas — I ate at the renowned rav.
